endpoints.name: conversations_search_conversation
endpoints.description: Search Conversations Returns a list of all conversations matching the search criteria along with the sort and filter options selected. [GET /conversations/search] Scopes: conversations.readonly.

assignedTo.description: User IDs that conversations are assigned to. Multiple IDs can be provided as comma-separated values. Use "unassigned" to fetch conversations not assigned to any user.

followers.description: User IDs of followers to filter conversations by. Multiple IDs can be provided as comma-separated values.

mentions.description: User Id of the mention. Multiple values are comma separated.

startAfterDate.description: Search to begin after the specified date - should contain the sort value of the last document

lastMessageType.description: Type of the last message in the conversation as a string

lastMessageAction.description: Action of the last outbound message in the conversation as string.

lastMessageDirection.description: Direction of the last message in the conversation as string.

status.description: The status of the conversation to be filtered - all, read, unread, starred

sortBy.description: The sorting of the conversation to be filtered as - manual messages or all messages

sortScoreProfile.description: Id of score profile on which sortBy.ScoreProfile should sort on

scoreProfile.description: Id of score profile on which conversations should get filtered out, works with scoreProfileMin & scoreProfileMax

startDate.description: Start date filter for dateAdded field (Unix timestamp in milliseconds)

endDate.description: End date filter for dateAdded field (Unix timestamp in milliseconds)

endpoints.name: conversations_get_conversation
endpoints.description: Get Conversation Get the conversation details based on the conversation ID [GET /conversations/{conversationId}] Scopes: conversations.readonly.

endpoints.name: conversations_update_conversation
endpoints.description: Update Conversation Update the conversation details based on the conversation ID [PUT /conversations/{conversationId}] Scopes: conversations.write.

unreadCount.description: Count of unread messages in the conversation

endpoints.name: conversations_delete_conversation
endpoints.description: Delete Conversation Delete the conversation details based on the conversation ID [DELETE /conversations/{conversationId}] Scopes: conversations.write.

endpoints.name: conversations_get_all_custom_subtypes
endpoints.description: Get All Custom Subtypes Get all custom subtypes for a location [GET /conversations/preferences/custom-subtypes]

endpoints.name: conversations_create_custom_subtype
endpoints.description: Create Custom Subtype Create a new custom subtype for a location. Requires agency or account admin role. [POST /conversations/preferences/custom-subtypes]

name.description: Name of the custom subtype (max 100 characters)

description.description: Description of the custom subtype (max 100 characters)

endpoints.name: conversations_update_custom_subtype
endpoints.description: Update Custom Subtype Update or archive a custom subtype. Requires agency or account admin role. [PUT /conversations/preferences/custom-subtypes/{id}]

name.description: Name of the custom subtype (max 100 characters)

description.description: Description of the custom subtype (max 100 characters)

archived.description: Whether the custom subtype is archived

resubscription_legal_form_id.description: Resubscription legal form ID (optional when archiving)

endpoints.name: conversations_get_contact_unsubscription_status
endpoints.description: Get Contact Unsubscription Status Get all subscription statuses for a contact (all emails or specific email) [GET /conversations/preferences/unsubscriptions/status]

email.description: Email address (optional - if not provided, gets all emails for contact)

endpoints.name: conversations_user_subscription_change
endpoints.description: User Subscription Change Process subscription change initiated by a user (admin/agent). Supports individual custom subscription changes and resub all functionality. Legal forms are automatically created for user-initiated resubscribe actions on custom subscriptions. [POST /conversations/preferences/unsubscriptions/user-change]

subtype_name.description: Subscription type name (required for default types: "One on One")

subtype_id.description: Custom subscription type ID (required for custom types)

legal_reason.description: Legal reason for the change (required only for resubscribe and resub_all actions)

endpoints.name: conversations_get_email_by_id
endpoints.description: Get email by Id [GET /conversations/messages/email/{id}]

endpoints.name: conversations_cancel_scheduled_email_message
endpoints.description:
Cancel a scheduled email message. Post the messageId for the API to delete a scheduled email message.
[DELETE /conversations/messages/email/{emailMessageId}/schedule]

endpoints.name: conversations_export_messages_by_location
endpoints.description: Export messages by location ID Export messages for a specific location with cursor-based pagination support. Response includes messageType (string), source, and subType fields. The channel parameter is optional - if not provided, all non-email message types will be returned including activity messages (opportunity updates, appointments, etc.). [GET /conversations/messages/export] Scopes: conversations/message.readonly.

locationId.description: Location ID to filter messages by

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination. Pass the nextCursor from previous response to get next page.

channel.description: Filter by message channel. If not provided, all non-email message types will be returned including activity messages (opportunity updates, appointments, etc.)

startDate.description: Start date to filter messages by

endDate.description: End date to filter messages by

endpoints.name: conversations_get_message
endpoints.description: Get message by message id . [GET /conversations/messages/{id}] Scopes: conversations/message.readonly.

endpoints.name: conversations_get_messages
endpoints.description: Get messages by conversation id . [GET /conversations/{conversationId}/messages] Scopes: conversations/message.readonly.

lastMessageId.description: Message ID of the last message in the list as a string

limit.description: Number of messages to be fetched from the conversation. Default limit is 20

type.description: Types of message to fetched separated with comma

endpoints.name: conversations_send_a_new_message
endpoints.description: Send a new message Post the necessary fields for the API to send a new message. [POST /conversations/messages] Scopes: conversations/message.write.

contactId.description: ID of the contact receiving the message

replyMessageId.description: ID of message being replied to

threadId.description: ID of message thread. For email messages, this is the message ID that contains multiple email messages in the thread

scheduledTimestamp.description: UTC Timestamp (in seconds) at which the message should be scheduled

emailTo.description: Email address to send to, if different from contact's primary email. This should be a valid email address associated with the contact.

customSubtypeId.description: Custom subtype ID for email unsubscription preferences. Only applies to email messages.

fromNumber.description: Phone number used as the sender number for outbound messages

toNumber.description: Recipient phone number for outbound messages

isForwarded.description: Specify if this is a forwarded email

forwardWholeThread.description: Specify if forwarding the whole thread or just a single email

messageId.description: Message ID of the email thread being forwarded (source) - REQUIRED for forwarding

emailMessageId.description: Email Message ID of the specific email being forwarded (source) - Required for single email forward, ignored for thread forward

sourceContactId.description: Contact ID where the forwarded email originated from (source) - Auto-populated if not provided

sourceConversationId.description: Conversation ID where the forwarded email originated from (source) - Auto-populated if not provided

recipientContactId.description: Contact ID of recipient when forwarding (destination)

recipientConversationId.description: Conversation ID of recipient when forwarding (destination)

usesNativeSchedulingAi.description: Whether the scheduled email uses native AI for the email scheduling

endpoints.name: conversations_add_an_inbound_message
endpoints.description:
Add an inbound message Post the necessary fields for the API to add a new inbound message.
[POST /conversations/messages/inbound] Scopes: conversations/message.write.

emailFrom.description: Email address to send from. This field is associated with the contact record and cannot be dynamically changed.

emailTo.description: Recipient email address. This field is associated with the contact record and cannot be dynamically changed.

emailCc.description: List of email address to CC

emailBcc.description: List of email address to BCC

emailMessageId.description: Send the email message id for which this email should be threaded. This is for replying to a specific email

direction.description: Message direction, if required can be set manually, default is outbound (default: "outbound")

call.description: Phone call dialer and receiver information

endpoints.name: conversations_add_an_outbound_message
endpoints.description: Add an external outbound call Post the necessary fields for the API to add a new outbound call. [POST /conversations/messages/outbound] Scopes: conversations/message.write.

call.description: Phone call dialer and receiver information

endpoints.name: conversations_send_review_reply
endpoints.summary: Send a review reply to Google My Business
endpoints.description: Send a review reply to Google My Business Post a reply to a customer review on Google My Business [POST /conversations/messages/review-reply] Scopes: conversations/message.write.

endpoints.name: conversations_cancel_scheduled_message
endpoints.description:
Cancel a scheduled message. Post the messageId for the API to delete a scheduled message.
[DELETE /conversations/messages/{messageId}/schedule] Scopes: conversations/message.write.

endpoints.name: conversations_upload_file_attachments
endpoints.description:
Upload file attachments Post the necessary fields for the API to upload files. The files need to be a buffer with the key "fileAttachment".

The allowed file types are:
  • JPG
  • JPEG
  • PNG
  • MP4
  • MPEG
  • ZIP
  • RAR
  • PDF
  • DOC
  • DOCX
  • TXT
  • MP3
  • WAV


The API will return an object with the URLs [POST /conversations/messages/upload] Scopes: conversations/message.write.

chatServiceSid.description: Twilio chat service SID for group SMS uploads

isGroupSms.description: Flag to indicate group SMS upload flow. When true, only 1 file upload is allowed per request.

endpoints.name: conversations_initiate_file_upload
endpoints.description: Initiate file upload to GCS Generates a signed URL for direct file upload to Google Cloud Storage. Returns a signed URL valid for 15 minutes. Upload file via PUT request, then call /complete to finalize. [POST /conversations/messages/upload/initiate] Scopes: conversations/message.write.

fileSize.description: File size in bytes (optional, for pre-validation)

channel.description: Channel type for size limits (WHATSAPP for 100MB limit, others for 5MB)

endpoints.name: conversations_complete_file_upload
endpoints.description: Complete file upload Validates the uploaded file in GCS and returns the public URL. Call this endpoint after successfully uploading the file to the signed URL. [POST /conversations/messages/upload/complete] Scopes: conversations/message.write.

endpoints.name: conversations_update_message_status
endpoints.description: Update message status Post the necessary fields for the API to update message status. [PUT /conversations/messages/{messageId}/status] Scopes: conversations/message.write.

error.description: Error object from the conversation provider

recipients.description: Email delivery status for additional email recipients.

endpoints.name: conversations_add_message_attachments
endpoints.description: Add message attachments Set attachments on an existing message (replaces existing). Maximum 5 URLs. Supported for TYPE_CUSTOM_CALL (34) and TYPE_CALL (1) with subType EXTERNAL_CALL. [PUT /conversations/messages/{messageId}/attachments] Scopes: conversations/message.write.

attachments.description: Array of attachment URLs to set on the message (replaces existing). Maximum 5 URLs.

endpoints.name: conversations_get_message_recording
endpoints.description: Get Recording by Message ID Get the recording for a message by passing the message id [GET /conversations/messages/{messageId}/locations/{locationId}/recording] Token: location. Scopes: conversations/message.readonly.

endpoints.name: conversations_get_message_transcription
endpoints.description: Get transcription by Message ID Get the recording transcription for a message by passing the message id [GET /conversations/locations/{locationId}/messages/{messageId}/transcription] Token: location. Scopes: conversations/message.readonly.

endpoints.name: conversations_download_message_transcription
endpoints.description: Download transcription by Message ID Download the recording transcription for a message by passing the message id [GET /conversations/locations/{locationId}/messages/{messageId}/transcription/download] Token: location. Scopes: conversations/message.readonly.

endpoints.name: conversations_live_chat_agent_typing
endpoints.summary: Agent/Ai-Bot is typing a message indicator for live chat
endpoints.description: Agent/Ai-Bot is typing a message indicator for live chat Agent/AI-Bot will call this when they are typing a message in live chat message [POST /conversations/providers/live-chat/typing] Token: location. Scopes: conversations/livechat.write.

visitorId.description: visitorId is the Unique ID assigned to each Live chat visitor. visitorId will be added soon in GET Contact API

endpoints.name: conversations_create_conversation
endpoints.description: Create Conversation Creates a new conversation with the data provided [POST /conversations/] Scopes: conversations.write.
